title: Checkout consumer lag
body:
## Symptoms
Consumer lag elevated.

## Known cause
Duplicate records created through the REST API cause a deserialization poison pill.

## Safe cleanup steps
1. Pause consumer group checkout-api-workers
2. Skip poison offset on partition with DeserializationException
3. Run cleanup for duplicate order_id rows
4. Resume consumer
5. Do not restart Kafka brokers without approval

title: DNS resolution failures
body:
## Symptoms
NXDOMAIN / UnknownHostException for internal hosts.

## Steps
1. Verify NXDOMAIN in app logs for the failing hostname
2. Check the latest DNS zone push / CNAME changes
3. Restore the missing record or fail over with network on-call approval
4. Do not restart app pods as the first remediation

title: Bad deploy rollback
body:
## Symptoms
Error-rate spike immediately after a release.

## Steps
1. Confirm deploy timestamp aligns with the error spike
2. Search logs for new exception fingerprints from the release
3. Disable the related feature flag if present
4. Rollback to the previous version if NPE / 5xx continues
5. Require human approval before database migrations
